description: List real emails from the Sequenzy email gallery to model a new email on, for the kind of email being written: campaign (promotions, newsletters, product updates), sequence (lifecycle emails plus whole sequences) or transactional. By default (scope similar) they come from the gallery brands most like the company: brands whose businesses (what each sells, and to whom) are closest in meaning to the company description, closest first (returned as brands; rankings are reused for up to 10 minutes). To rank them, the company description and any search text are sent to an embeddings service; nothing is saved. Each item has a gallery url that create_template_from_example (or create_sequence_from_example for a sequence) accepts, and emails carry an analysis (main button, length, layout, voice, structure and why it works; null until analyzed) to choose a model by. With scope all it browses the whole gallery instead; search narrows either. profile is missing (and the list empty) when the company has no description or company context yet; use scope all then. Requires templates:read.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

limit.description: Most emails to return, 1-60, defaults to 24, for scope similar without search (otherwise pages hold the gallery page size). Also caps the sequences returned.

page.description: Page of results when scope is all or search is set (pageCount says how many). Defaults to 1.

scope.description: similar (default): emails from the gallery brands most like the company. all: the whole Sequenzy email gallery for this kind of email, a page at a time.

search.description: Optional words to search the emails by meaning, up to 80 characters, e.g. 'black friday countdown'.

subtype.description: Optional gallery subtype to list first, e.g. password_reset, receipt, welcome or abandoned_cart. Only for scope similar without search.

name: list_email_references
